verdicts.decision_note: The client specifies a passive buzzer, establishing the electrical interface type for the PCB.
The client identifies a concrete passive SMD buzzer with explicit package dimensions and supported operating voltages.

value_updates.prototype_part_usage: Use the AliExpress buzzer for prototyping
value_updates.production_part_policy: A suitable alternative available from LCSC is acceptable

verdicts.decision_note: The client limits the exact AliExpress part to prototyping and permits a different sourceable production part, so its exact package and voltage attributes must not remain global production constraints.
The client unambiguously approves the immediately preceding LCSC buzzer proposal as the production hardware choice.
